Ethernet Type

Setup the Ethernet type as Gigabit Ethernet or Fast Ethernet.

  • Gigabit Ethernet will provide data speed up to 1000 Mbps.
  • Fast Ethernet will provide data speed up to 100 Mbps.

Energy Efficient Ethernet

  • Enabled: Energy Efficient Ethernet is enabled.
  • Disabled: Energy Efficient Ethernet is disabled.
